Supported scenarios — what they actually publish

Edge Delta does not publish ERROR · SLOWDOWN · AVAILABILITY. They publish three catalogs that stack as jobs — not as Node / Gateway / Team. Hub one-story: ED hub. Markdown: EDGEDELTA_SUPPORTED_SCENARIOS.md.

How to clean this source. Lives inside a pipeline (Node or Gateway). No alert.

10 use cases

Who investigates, with which connectors. The only catalog that is the AI Team.

Do not twin: 10 use cases ≠ 6 Davis categories ≠ 11 Datadog Host+APM templates. Pattern Anomaly ≠ Watchdog ≠ Davis Event. Issue ≠ Problem ≠ Bits.

How the three catalogs differ

One pipeline, three jobs. They are not three names for the same list, and they are not Node / Gateway / AI Team.

Do not map catalogs onto deploy SKUs

Packs can sit on Node or Gateway. Monitor types can fire as Pipeline Triggers (edge) or org Monitors (platform). Use cases run on the AI Team. Gateway is an aggregation pipeline, not the monitor catalog.

2. Eight monitor types (Detect mechanisms)

Getting Started lists seven create-able types (includes Event, omits Metric Anomaly). The Monitors section documents Metric Anomaly as its own page and omits Event. Union = 8.

TypeJobDavis-like category?
Metric ThresholdFixed numeric thresholdNo
Metric ChangeRate-of-change vs historyNo
Metric AnomalyRolling mean ± NσNo
Log ThresholdLog volume / severity countsNo
Pattern AnomalyUnusual log-pattern spikeNo
Event (UI: Event Threshold)Event-source thresholds (e.g. GitHub)No
CompositeCombine other monitor conditionsNo
SyntheticPeriodic HTTP checkNo

Two Detect locations (not extra types): Pipeline Triggers at the edge (one pipeline) ∥ Monitors in the backend (cross-pipeline).

Term key: Pipeline Trigger = threshold/rule inside one pipeline (edge-side door); org Monitor = backend monitor across indexed data (platform door); Pattern Anomaly = spike detector on clustered log patterns, not a generic error class.

6. E1–E11 on what you deploy

Honesty: Observed Node-only lab on RTX (17–18 Aug) plus Cloud ingest for UC9. No Gateway pipeline ID. IPO + reach matrix: 02 Breakdown. Hub one-story: catalogs vs deploy vs stages.

You install Node and Gateway in the cluster. After egress sits the platform (index + org monitors). The AI Team sits on that platform. Extra: Coordinator (mostly E5). Same E1→E11 order; only locus moves left.

Term key: Node = per-node DaemonSet collector; Gateway = cluster Deployment aggregator; platform = SaaS index + monitors + explorers; Coordinator = fleet/control-plane helper, not a fourth catalog.

Phase rollup · who owns the work
P1 Fabric · E1–E5

Node ∥ Gateway (shift left). Platform persists (E4). Team only reads.

P2 Triage · E6–E8

E6 three doors (Node · Gateway · org Monitor). E7–E8 Team.

P3 Diagnose · E9–E11

Standing AI Team. Pipelines stay the evidence factory.

Legend: P primary · A assist · R read · — not this layer.

E6 is the only stage with three real doors. That is why the 8 monitor types are not “the Gateway catalog.” P3 does not idle the pipelines: Diagnose reads the estate they keep writing.
